mapping.summary: Manages own vehicle fleet, drivers, ride logs, fuel, maintenance and transport dispatch.
claims: Driver cards hold qualifications, licences and permit expiry dates
Vehicle records with equipment, standard costs, consumption rates and a default driver
Digital ride log with route, vehicle, driver and operation type, posted as entries
Fuel journals from supplier fuel purchases generate purchase invoices
Vehicle maintenance scheduled by mileage or time interval
Transport requests created from purchase and sales orders
Dispatcher board shows new, planned and closed transport requests
Analysis of vehicle cost, fuel use and drive statistics
Integrated with standard purchase, sales and transfer documents
Posted ledger entries give an audit history of drives and fuel costs
Available in English, Czech and Slovak
